name: ListRow
description: One row of a list. It renders a `button` by default; pass `render={<a />}` (or a router link) for a row that goes somewhere. Children are the leading block (an avatar, a channel or icon tile, `ListRowIcon`), `ListRowBody`, and anything trailing (a value, a badge, a switch, `ListRowChevron`).

props.name: interactive
props.description: `false` renders a display-only row: a `div` with no hover or press, for a row whose controls (a switch, a button) are its only targets.

props.name: selected
props.description: The item open beside the list: the row takes the cyan wash and stops reacting to hover. Say why it is selected with `aria-current` or `aria-selected` yourself.

props.name: tone
props.description: Something waits for you here (bold title, ink preview), the place is muted (ink-2 title), or you are not in it yet (ink-3 title and preview). A disabled row ignores it: everything is ink-disabled.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: ListRowBody
description: The text column: the title and the preview, or a `ListRowTop` and a `ListRowBottom`.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: ListRowBottom
description: The second line: the preview, then at most one badge.
